Both a professor and a parking attendant had their bags searched at the airport. A drug-sniffing dog had signalled that officers should look into the bag of the professor and, sure enough, they found quite a bit of cocaine. After the parking attendant's bag was flagged and searched, though, they were let go as it was apparently just a false alarm. Who had drugs on them?
A. Cannot answer
B. The professor
C. The parking attendant
